description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Moratuwa D/S Division - Cad. Map NO. 520207 & other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including detailed land parcel information (cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, extent of land), and procedures for claiming property rights under the Registration of Title Act. It focuses exclusively on land and property-related administrative matters, fitting the Land Gazette classification criteria.
